Tests equivalent to or higher than Prøve i Dansk 3 include: Prøve i Dansk 3 with a grade average of at least 6 on the 13-point scale (or 02 on the 7-point scale); the studieprøven with a grade average of at least 6 on the 13-point scale (or 02 on the 7-point scale) in each test; and 9th or 10th grade final exams with a grade average of at least 6 on the 13-point scale (or 02 on the 7-point scale) in Danish disciplines (excluding conduct).
